ensures: supervise_worker is total over ordinary malformed or unavailable inputs and returns one closed immutable IsolatedWorkerResult with status completed, refused, unsupported, exhausted, cancelled, failed, or invalid; no ordinary failure returns a successful or authority-bearing partial result.

The supervisor strictly parses and recomputes request identity, planning-result identity and selected strategy, parent-budget identity and available capacity, artifact inventory, executable identity, workspace safety, platform capability, and exact resource allocation before process creation.

Before launch, the supervisor appends one exact reserve event to a private derived parent ledger, creates a child ledger with exact lineage and allocation identity, and validates both under MH-C-RESOURCE-BUDGET-001; insufficient or invalid capacity refuses without creating a process.

Every producer runs out of process with shell disabled, standard input closed, only direct explicit arguments, a minimal allowlisted environment, a private real working directory, non-inheritable unrelated handles, bounded binary stdout and stderr sinks, and no in-process plugin import or callable execution.

Linux and macOS workers begin in a fresh POSIX session and inherit hard CPU, address-space, file-size, descriptor, and process limits where the host exposes them; Windows workers are assigned before resumption to a kill-on-close Job Object with process-tree CPU and memory limits.

A parent monotonic deadline enforces wall_time_us. Output and diagnostic file sizes are sampled without retaining over their limits. Cancellation, deadline, output exhaustion, launch or protocol failure, parent interruption, and supervisor failure enter one cleanup path before an ordinary result can escape.

Cleanup first requests graceful complete-containment termination when safe, then forcefully terminates the process group or closes and terminates the Job Object, closes every pipe and handle, waits or reaps the root and adopted observable descendants, and records whether complete tree cleanup was established.

A completed result requires zero exit status, no cancellation, exhaustion, truncation, protocol defect, containment loss, active process, unclosed handle, or cleanup defect. Completion means only that the isolated producer returned bounded bytes; it does not mean supported mathematics, valid evidence, a proof, or a refutation.

Wall, CPU, memory, solver-call, generated-object, proof, evidence, output, diagnostic, nesting, exit and signal observations are recorded in one closed usage value. Unsupported observations are explicit through usage_complete false and can never be forged into complete accounting.

Stdout and stderr become at most two closed digest-and-length artifact records. Bytes beyond a declared ceiling are not retained, their omission is explicit, and any output or diagnostic exhaustion prevents completed status and producer-artifact promotion.

Every ordinary terminal path closes the child budget, reconciles the reserved lease exactly once into a derived parent budget using allocation plus overrun equals usage plus refund in each dimension, and exposes immutable exact child and parent budget bytes whose hashes match the result.

If launch never occurs, no child usage is claimed and the reservation is either absent or reconciled as zero use. If cleanup or accounting cannot be established, status is failed, tree_terminated or lease_reconciled is false as appropriate, and no producer bytes are authority-bearing.

The semantic identity binds contract, request, plan, strategy, platform capability, terminal status, reason, retained artifact identities, diagnostics, cleanup and reconciliation booleans while excluding PID, handle values, temporary paths, absolute clocks, raw monotonic samples, and platform-specific exit encoding; the full result identity additionally binds exact usage and budget digests.

All public request, capability, usage, artifact, diagnostic and result values are closed final immutable values; direct construction, subclassing, mutation, alias mutation, dataclass replacement, pickling, noncanonical parsing, repaired hashes, or copied status fields cannot create a valid result.

MemoryError, KeyboardInterrupt, and SystemExit trigger best-effort complete tree termination, handle closure and process reaping and then propagate unchanged; they can never become completed, producer evidence, checker attestation, or mathematical authority.

epistemics.cancelled: the supervisor observed explicit cancellation and terminated the containment unit; no partial producer output is successful
epistemics.completed: one isolated producer exited zero within enforced bounds and cleanup and accounting completed; its bytes remain an untrusted producer report requiring the planned checker
epistemics.exhausted: one exact resource dimension crossed or could not satisfy its ceiling, the containment unit was terminated, and no partial output has success authority
epistemics.failed: launch, exit, signal, protocol, cleanup, accounting, or supervisor behavior prevented a valid bounded completion
epistemics.invalid: request, plan, strategy, budget, artifact, executable, path, identity, schema, or canonical input failed before a valid execution result existed
epistemics.mathematical_truth: never inferred from process isolation, resource enforcement, exit status, deterministic bytes, producer agreement, cleanup, or budget completion
epistemics.refused: a known request cannot run because capacity, executable or workspace preconditions fail without launching a producer
epistemics.unsupported: the host cannot establish the contracted containment primitive and the producer is not launched

invariants: The six normative schemas are exact, closed, content-addressed, compiled into production, and independently rebound before any request, nested value, or result is accepted.

Request selection is by exact plan and strategy identity only; family, descriptor, resource vector, effects, executable and artifacts cannot be inferred from names, prose, keywords, environment, history, or process output.

The executable is never searched through PATH, a shell, current directory, file association, extension probing, or caller command string; the exact absolute regular file is opened and hashed before direct launch.

The private working directory and output sinks are created before launch beneath one validated explicit root, are never named in canonical output, and are removed only after the containment unit and every owned handle are closed.

No child inherits an unrelated descriptor, handle, standard input stream, caller HOME, user-site path, Python path, proxy, credential, token, secret, current directory, locale, hash seed, or package-manager configuration.

Every launch is contained before producer code may intentionally create descendants: POSIX uses a fresh session with inherited limits, and Windows starts suspended, assigns a kill-on-close Job Object, then resumes.

Wall timeout and cancellation are parent-enforced; CPU and memory ceilings use the exact declared platform primitive. Per-process POSIX address-space semantics and Windows tree-job semantics are never mislabeled as one another.

The supervisor retains at most the declared output and diagnostic ceilings, never blocks forever on descendant-held pipes, and treats any omitted positive byte count or unknown original length as exhausted or failed rather than completed.

The root process is waited exactly once, every owned handle is closed exactly once, cleanup is idempotent, and ordinary return with tree_terminated true requires no observable live member in the created containment unit.

Reservation precedes launch, child usage is committed once, reconciliation closes the exact lease once, and allocation plus overrun equals usage plus refund independently in all ten accepted dimensions.

Measured wall time, process-tree memory peak and nesting are observational ResourceBudget dimensions; CPU, solver calls, generated objects, proof, evidence, output and diagnostics are cumulative dimensions and are never double charged to parent and child.

Completed requires tree_terminated true, lease_reconciled true, usage_complete true, zero exit, no signal, zero omitted output, supported containment, and exactly one non-authoritative stdout artifact plus optional stderr artifact.

Invalid, refused, unsupported, exhausted, cancelled and failed results have mathematical_authority false and cannot contain a valid Evidence, Certificate, checker result, proof term, trust transition, or external proof-assistant authority.

No worker result contains a callable, module, plugin instance, process, PID, raw handle, open file, event object, clock origin, temporary path, workspace path, executable path, environment value, secret, or mutable alias.

Any repaired outer identity, copied zero exit, forged usage, forged capability, changed limit, changed artifact, changed executable bytes, stale plan, reused lease, orphaned process, or incomplete cleanup invalidates or downgrades the result without mathematical authority.
raises: IsolatedWorkerValidationError with kind type, encoding, json, duplicate, schema, canonical, identity, contract, request, plan, strategy, artifact, budget, executable, path, platform, containment, protocol, accounting, cleanup, result, or limit is raised only by explicitly requested strict parsers, serializers, hashers, validators, accessors, and unrecoverable pre-launch API misuse.

Ordinary malformed, stale, mismatched, insufficient, unsupported, unavailable, exhausted, cancelled, nonzero-exit, signalled, truncated, protocol-invalid, launch-failed, cleanup-failed, or supervisor-failed cases return their exact closed non-authoritative result.
PermissionError is raised for direct public construction; TypeError is raised for subclass and pickle attempts; safe copy preserves immutable identity or fails.

MemoryError, KeyboardInterrupt, and SystemExit propagate only after the supervisor has attempted containment termination, handle closure, and root reaping; no ordinary result converts them into success.
